title: PM-Tricks overall progress 2% vs 2 of 67 lessons watched
label: Conflicting Data
detail: 2/67 = 2.99%, which rounds to 3%, not 2%. By watched video time it is 4.55%. Two explanations fit 2%: the platform truncates (floor) the percentage, or it counts the 14 tests in the denominator (2/81 = 2.47%).
handling: Platform value 2% is preserved. The app will never compute 'platform progress' itself.
toResolve: Record the current PM-Tricks % (baseline 2% at 2 watched lessons), watch exactly ONE more lesson, record the new % and watched count. 3/67 floors to 4% (rounds to 4%); 3/81 = 3.7% (floors to 3%, rounds to 4%). A result of 3% points to the 81-item denominator; 4% is consistent with both.
closeRequires: Evidence (what you saw, where, and when). Values are never overwritten when a discrepancy is closed.
